__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource for Netflix LLM Platform metrics

description: Comprehensive GPU inference monitoring for the Netflix Real-Time LLM Personalization & Inference Platform. Covers inference latency, GPU health, KV cache, batching, and multi-region metrics.

links.title: Related Dashboards
links.tooltip: Navigate to related Netflix LLM dashboards

panels.description: 95th percentile inference latency across all requests in the selected region. SLO target: < 200ms.
panels.title: p95 Inference Latency

panels.description: Total inference requests per second broken down by status code.
panels.title: Requests per Second

panels.description: Percentage of inference requests resulting in errors (5xx, timeouts, OOM). SLO target: < 1%.
panels.title: Error Rate

panels.description: GPU utilization percentage for each device in the tensor-parallel group (TP=4). High utilization (>90%) sustained may indicate need for additional capacity.
panels.title: GPU Utilization per Device (TP=4)

panels.description: GPU memory usage for each device showing allocated vs total HBM memory.
panels.title: GPU Memory Usage

panels.description: Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) occupancy percentage. Higher occupancy indicates better kernel utilization of GPU compute resources.
panels.title: SM Occupancy

panels.description: Tensor Core utilization as a percentage of peak throughput. Key metric for LLM inference workloads using mixed-precision (FP16/BF16) operations.
panels.title: Tensor Core Utilization

panels.description: Current KV cache utilization as a percentage of total allocated cache blocks. High utilization triggers eviction and may degrade latency.
panels.title: KV Cache Utilization

panels.description: Prefix cache hit rate for the KV cache. Higher hit rates reduce redundant computation for common prompt prefixes.
panels.title: Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Memory fragmentation ratio of the KV cache block allocator. High fragmentation reduces effective cache capacity and increases eviction pressure.
panels.title: Memory Fragmentation

panels.description: Rate of KV cache block evictions per second. Sustained high eviction rates indicate insufficient cache capacity for the workload.
panels.title: Eviction Rate

panels.description: Distribution of dynamic batch sizes used for continuous batching. Shows how effectively the scheduler is filling batches.
panels.title: Dynamic Batch Size Distribution

panels.description: Total tokens generated per second across all inference workers. SLO minimum: 3000 tokens/sec per region.
panels.title: Tokens per Second

panels.description: Number of inference requests waiting in the scheduling queue. Sustained high queue depth indicates insufficient serving capacity.
panels.title: Queue Depth

panels.description: Estimated cost per 1000 tokens generated, computed from GPU-hours consumed and token throughput.
panels.title: Cost per 1k Tokens

panels.description: p95 inference latency compared across all three serving regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1) to identify regional performance disparities.
panels.title: Regional Latency Comparison

panels.description: Cross-region inference traffic showing request routing between regions for load balancing and failover scenarios.
panels.title: Cross-Region Traffic

panels.description: Log of regional failover events showing timestamp, source region, target region, reason, and duration.
panels.title: Failover Events
